segments.text:
Hi Maya,

Attached is the order form for 65 seats of Workflow Plus, annual term 9/1/2026–8/31/2027. Total is $49,140 before tax, invoiced on signature. Implementation package is included for the Sept. 9 kickoff.

Thanks,
Evan

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Evan,

Thanks. The seat count is right, but this is coming in a little high for our Q3 budget. We had $45k earmarked including implementation. Can you take another look?

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Maya,

Yeah, understood. Use the $44,700 number from my chat for your PO so you can keep approvals moving; the PDF will catch up once it comes out of the queue.

Evan

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Ok, that works. Please keep the start date as Sept. 1 and the kickoff on Sept. 9. We need access for the first 20 users by Sept. 3.

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Got it. I’ll provision the first 20 seats on Sept. 3 once the signed order is back. Remaining 45 can be added before kickoff or in batches, whichever is easier for your team.

Evan

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Please set the invoice contact to ap@northlakeparts.com and include PO-78219 on the invoice. Net 30 is still in the terms, correct?

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Yes, net 30 is in there. Invoice will go to AP with PO-78219 referenced. Billing address I have is 1180 Kincaid Rd, Suite 400, Columbus, OH 43215.

Evan

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Address is correct. Send the final order form to me and Jordan Lee for signature when ready.

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Will do. I’ll send it to both of you today. After signature, customer success will send the onboarding checklist and calendar invite for Sept. 9.

Evan
